items.name: Classic/Spanish 双骰策略
items.core_loop: 双骰出巢→分配步数→三次双数受罚
items.distinctive: 同一骰史在变体下对应不同处罚棋子

rules.门槛: 单骰或和5出一子；双5出两子
rules.时序: 双数再投；三连双数处罚

evidence_refs.name: englishlocalization
evidence_refs.quote: A token can come out of the nest when player rolls 5 in a single dice or the sum of two dice. Two tokens can come out when player rolls double 5.

evidence_refs.name: englishlocalization
evidence_refs.quote: Tip: In Spanish rule, the last moved token will be sent back to nest when player rolled double three times continuously.

evidence_refs.name: englishlocalization
evidence_refs.quote: Tip: In Classic rule, the most advanced token will be sent back to nest when player rolled double three times continuously.

items.name: 路障与强制拆障
items.core_loop: 同色两子同格→阻塞所有玩家→掷双数必须拆己障
items.distinctive: 防守占位也会阻挡自己

evidence_refs.name: englishlocalization
evidence_refs.quote: If two tokens of the same color stay in the same box then they form a blockade. Neither the player's token or opponents' token can cross blockade. If a player can't move any token because of blockade then this turn is invalid. Note: If the player rolls double then it is forced to break blockade.

items.distinctive: 一次行动可带来二次策略选择

items.name: 礼物专属 Sponsor 冠名
items.core_loop: 给某人送特定礼物→该礼物数量第一→成为冠名赞助
items.distinctive: 按收礼者×礼物种类分割关系荣誉

rules.门槛: 特定礼物最高数量；同分先达到优先
rules.时序: GMT-5周一至周日，更新延迟5–30分钟，新周清空

evidence_refs.name: englishlocalization
evidence_refs.quote:
1. The sponsors are typically calculated weekly, from Monday 00:00 to Sunday 24:00 (GMT-5).
2. The user who sends the highest quantity of a specific gift to a player will be the sponsor of that gift. In case of a tie, the one who reaches the quantity first will be prioritized.
3. If a player does not receive a specific gift during the week, there will be no sponsor of this gift.
4. At the start of a new cycle, the previous sponsor information will be cleared.
5. The update may take approximately 5 to 30 minutes.
